_comment: agent-fabric ADR-045 §5 rule 1 (j222): the modules tools/fabric/roots_bypass.py admits although they find a tree or an instance-data path without tools/fabric/roots.py. Each value says why. An entry admits the whole module, a later bypass in it included; an entry that admits nothing is lint's finding, so a gap's entry leaves with its fix.

modules.runtime/provisioning/moveto/moveto.py: copied to hosts as share/moveto/moveto.py (tools/fabric/hosttools.py MOVETO_FILES): it runs where tools/fabric/roots.py does not exist, and ~/projects/agent-fabric is the account's own clone
modules.tools/fabric/assembler/intake.py: refuse_foreign_root must see the operator variable exactly as exported, to refuse a tree other than the checkout the drain is in; roots would answer the fallback it is checking against
modules.tools/fabric/launcher/routing.py: saves and restores AGENT_FABRIC_ROOT around loading routing.py, which reads it at import: it handles the variable, it does not resolve a tree
modules.tools/fabric/lint_rules/mechanisms.py: outside python-dev's entry (the lint); it names its policy file by a constant for the tree lint was handed
modules.tools/fabric/review_cli.py: the pre-pin stub: runs on whatever python3 the host has, sets the variable for the pinned child and imports nothing of the fabric, so a host without the pin still says so
